v.s: RVC Next 的服务器默认只监听本机（127.0.0.1:7868），只有这台电脑上的浏览器能打开。本页说明怎样让局域网里的其他设备访问，以及服务器为此采取的保护措施。
远程访问与安全 — RVC Next
基于检索的语音转换（RVC）的一体化重写：转换、实时变声、人声分离、训练与模型管理。

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-house lucide-home\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"M15 21v-8a1 1 0 0 0-1-1h-4a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v8\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M3 10a2 2 0 0 1 .709-1.528l7-6a2 2 0 0 1 2.582 0l7 6A2 2 0 0 1 21 10v9a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2z\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>
RVC Next 是 Retrieval-based-Voice-Conversion-WebUI（下文称“原版 RVC”）的一体化重写。

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-rocket\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"M12 15v5s3.03-.55 4-2c1.08-1.62 0-5 0-5\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M4.5 16.5c-1.5 1.26-2 5-2 5s3.74-.5 5-2c.71-.84.7-2.13-.09-2.91a2.18 2.18 0 0 0-2.91-.09\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M9 12a22 22 0 0 1 2-3.95A12.88 12.88 0 0 1 22 2c0 2.72-.78 7.5-6 11a22.4 22.4 0 0 1-4 2z\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M9 12H4s.55-3.03 2-4c1.62-1.08 5 .05 5 .05\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>
本页介绍如何安装 RVC Next：准备一个独立的 Python 环境，先安装适合你硬件的 PyTorch，再安装 RVC Next 本身，最后用 rvc-next doctor 检查安装结果。

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-download\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"M12 15V3\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"m7 10 5 5 5-5\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>
装好 RVC Next 之后，本页带你走完第一次使用的全过程：启动网页界面，了解数据存放在哪里，下载转换必需的 HuBERT 和 RMVPE，获取一个示例音色，最后完成一次转换。每一步都同时给出网页界面和命令行两种做法。

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-play\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"M5 5a2 2 0 0 1 3.008-1.728l11.997 6.998a2 2 0 0 1 .003 3.458l-12 7A2 2 0 0 1 5 19z\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>
这一部分逐页讲解 RVC Next 网页界面的用法。

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-book-open\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"M12 5v16\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M20.001 19A2 2 0 0022 17V5a2 2 0 00-1.999-2L16 3.002A5 5 0 0012 5a5 5 0 00-4-2H4a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 001.999 2H8a5 5 0 014 2 5 5 0 014-2z\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>
本页介绍 RVC Next 网页界面的整体布局，以及在各个页面中反复出现的部分：导航、顶部栏、页面底部的操作栏、任务卡片、结果列表和页面之间的“传递”。掌握这些之后，阅读具体页面的教程会轻松很多。

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-layout-dashboard\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Crect width=\"7\" height=\"9\" x=\"3\" y=\"3\" rx=\"1\">\x3C/rect>\x3Crect width=\"7\" height=\"5\" x=\"14\" y=\"3\" rx=\"1\">\x3C/rect>\x3Crect width=\"7\" height=\"9\" x=\"14\" y=\"12\" rx=\"1\">\x3C/rect>\x3Crect width=\"7\" height=\"5\" x=\"3\" y=\"16\" rx=\"1\">\x3C/rect>\x3C/svg>
转换 页面把音频文件转换成选定音色的声音。它可以处理单个文件，也可以一次处理多个文件或整个文件夹；还可以在转换前先分离人声，转换后再把伴奏加回去，一次完成一首歌的翻唱。

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-audio-lines\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"M2 10v3\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M6 6v11\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M10 3v18\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M14 8v7\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M18 5v13\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M22 10v3\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>
实时 页面把麦克风里的声音即时转换成所选音色，再送到耳机、扬声器或虚拟声卡（例如给直播、语音聊天软件使用）。整个页面从上到下分成三块：音频设备、音色与参数、缓冲与降噪，底部固定着 开始 / 停止 按钮和状态栏。

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-mic\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"M12 19v3\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M19 10v2a7 7 0 0 1-14 0v-2\">\x3C/path>\x3Crect x=\"9\" y=\"2\" width=\"6\" height=\"13\" rx=\"3\">\x3C/rect>\x3C/svg>
在其他程序中使用实时变声
把实时变声的声音当作麦克风，送进 Discord、Zoom、OBS、游戏或任何其他程序：分步讲解 Windows（VB-CABLE 或 Voicemeeter）、macOS（BlackHole）和 Linux（PipeWire 或 PulseAudio 虚拟麦克风）上的虚拟声卡设置。

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-cable\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"M17 19a1 1 0 0 1-1-1v-2a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2a1 1 0 0 1-1 1z\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M17 21v-2\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M19 14V6.5a1 1 0 0 0-7 0v11a1 1 0 0 1-7 0V10\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M21 21v-2\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M3 5V3\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M4 10a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h4a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v2a2 2 0 0 1-2 2z\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M7 5V3\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>
分离 页面用 RoFormer 系列模型拆分音频：把歌曲分成人声与伴奏、去除人声中的混响、把主唱与和声分开。几个步骤还可以串联成一个预设一次完成。分出的任何分轨都可以直接送到 转换 页。

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-split\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"M16 3h5v5\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M8 3H3v5\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M12 22v-8.3a4 4 0 0 0-1.172-2.872L3 3\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"m15 9 6-6\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>
训练 页面用你自己的录音训练新音色。每次训练是一个实验：一个独立的文件夹，里面保存数据集设置、各阶段的中间结果、检查点和训练曲线。训练完成后，可以直接试听某个检查点，满意后一键导出到音色库。

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-graduation-cap\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"M21.42 10.922a1 1 0 0 0-.019-1.838L12.83 5.18a2 2 0 0 0-1.66 0L2.6 9.08a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.832l8.57 3.908a2 2 0 0 0 1.66 0z\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M22 10v6\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M6 12.5V16a6 3 0 0 0 12 0v-3.5\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>
模型 页面集中管理 rvc-next 用到的所有模型文件：你的音色、训练用的底模、人声分离模型，以及 HuBERT、RMVPE 等必需的资源文件。页面顶部有五个标签页：

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-library\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"m16 6 4 14\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M12 6v14\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M8 8v12\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M4 4v16\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>
音色参数 决定转换出来的声音：音高、共振峰、音高算法、索引强度、辅音保护和响度匹配，以及多说话人音色的说话人。RVC Next 在 转换、实时 和音色详情页的 默认参数 中使用同一个参数面板，名称、范围、默认值、说明和顺序完全一致；命令行和 API 也使用同一组参数和同样的范围。

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-sliders-horizontal\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"M10 5H3\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M12 19H3\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M14 3v4\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M16 17v4\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M21 12h-9\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M21 19h-5\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M21 5h-7\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M8 10v4\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M8 12H3\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>
设置 页面集中了 rvc-next 的所有选项，按八个标签页分组：常规、计算、音频、存储、下载、训练默认值、外观、关于。

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-terminal\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"M12 19h8\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"m4 17 6-6-6-6\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>
本页按命令树列出 rvc-next 的每条命令和子命令，内容来自各命令的 --help 输出。命令和子命令在帮助中按字母顺序排列，本页按用途分组。

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-square-terminal lucide-terminal-square\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"m7 11 2-2-2-2\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M11 13h4\">\x3C/path>\x3Crect width=\"18\" height=\"18\" x=\"3\" y=\"3\" rx=\"2\" ry=\"2\">\x3C/rect>\x3C/svg>
rvc-next 的设置保存在数据目录的 settings.toml 里，Web UI 的 设置 页、rvc-next config 命令和环境变量改的是同一份设置。本页列出全部设置项、环境变量和数据目录的结构。

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-file-cog lucide-file-cog-2\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"M15 8a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V2a2.4 2.4 0 0 1 1.704.706l3.588 3.588A2.4 2.4 0 0 1 20 8z\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M20 8v12a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-4.182\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"m3.305 19.53.923-.382\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M4 10.592V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h8\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"m4.228 16.852-.924-.383\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"m5.852 15.228-.383-.923\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"m5.852 20.772-.383.924\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"m8.148 15.228.383-.923\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"m8.53 21.696-.382-.924\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"m9.773 16.852.922-.383\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"m9.773 19.148.922.383\">\x3C/path>\x3Ccircle cx=\"7\" cy=\"18\" r=\"3\">\x3C/circle>\x3C/svg>
这一部分面向已经能正常使用 RVC Next、想进一步调整的用户：沿用原版 RVC 的文件、让其他电脑访问服务器、根据显卡调整性能，以及排查常见问题。

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-compass\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Ccircle cx=\"12\" cy=\"12\" r=\"10\">\x3C/circle>\x3Cpath d=\"m16.24 7.76-1.804 5.411a2 2 0 0 1-1.265 1.265L7.76 16.24l1.804-5.411a2 2 0 0 1 1.265-1.265z\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>
RVC Next 是 Retrieval-based-Voice-Conversion-WebUI（以提交 81eed5e 为基准）的重写。

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-arrow-right-left\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"m16 3 4 4-4 4\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M20 7H4\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"m8 21-4-4 4-4\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M4 17h16\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>
RVC Next 的服务器默认只监听本机（127.0.0.1:7868），只有这台电脑上的浏览器能打开。本页说明怎样让局域网里的其他设备访问，以及服务器为此采取的保护措施。

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-globe\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Ccircle cx=\"12\" cy=\"12\" r=\"10\">\x3C/circle>\x3Cpath d=\"M12 2a14.5 14.5 0 0 0 0 20 14.5 14.5 0 0 0 0-20\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M2 12h20\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>
在你自己的 Python 程序（启动器、整合包、其他 WebUI）里启动 RVC Next 的服务端和网页界面：数据目录与配置目录分开、固定设置、路径前缀，以及挂载到已有的 FastAPI 应用。
本页说明 RVC Next 怎样选择计算设备和精度、怎样管理显存，以及影响速度和实时延迟的设置。

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-cpu\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"M12 20v2\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M12 2v2\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M17 20v2\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M17 2v2\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M2 12h2\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M2 17h2\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M2 7h2\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M20 12h2\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M20 17h2\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M20 7h2\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M7 20v2\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M7 2v2\">\x3C/path>\x3Crect x=\"4\" y=\"4\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" rx=\"2\">\x3C/rect>\x3Crect x=\"8\" y=\"8\" width=\"8\" height=\"8\" rx=\"1\">\x3C/rect>\x3C/svg>
按主题整理的常见问题。点开问题查看解答。遇到问题时，先运行 rvc-next doctor：它会检查 torch 和 CUDA、音频设备和资源，并给出修复命令。

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-circle-question-mark lucide-help-circle lucide-circle-help\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Ccircle cx=\"12\" cy=\"12\" r=\"10\">\x3C/circle>\x3Cpath d=\"M9.09 9a3 3 0 0 1 5.83 1c0 2-3 3-3 3\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M12 17h.01\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>
这一部分写给要修改、扩展或审查 RVC Next 代码的人：维护者、贡献者，以及在这个仓库里工作的编程智能体。

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-code\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"m16 18 6-6-6-6\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"m8 6-6 6 6 6\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>
本页说明怎样搭一个能跑完整检查的开发环境、scripts/dev.py 里每个任务做什么、怎样构建 wheel 和这个文档站，以及 pyproject.toml 里各条依赖约束背后的原因。

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-wrench\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"M14.7 6.3a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.4l1.6 1.6a1 1 0 0 0 1.4 0l3.106-3.105c.32-.322.863-.22.983.218a6 6 0 0 1-8.259 7.057l-7.91 7.91a1 1 0 0 1-2.999-3l7.91-7.91a6 6 0 0 1 7.057-8.259c.438.12.54.662.219.984z\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>
本页给出 RVC Next 的全貌：包结构与分层规则、服务怎样被组装、哪些工作在哪个进程里运行、一个请求从浏览器到引擎再回来的路径，以及贯穿各层的几样基础设施：错误、设置、事件、数据库和数据目录。

核心层（rvcnext/core/）是 RVC Next 的全部业务逻辑：任务调度、显存管理、资源下载、音色库与导入、转换、人声分离、训练、实时变声，以及它们共用的设置、事件和数据库。API 与命令行都只是它的薄外壳，引擎（rvcnext/engine/）只被它以函数调用的方式使用，且只在函数内部惰性导入 torch。

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-plug\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"M12 22v-5\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M15 8V2\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M17 8a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v4a4 4 0 0 1-4 4h-4a4 4 0 0 1-4-4V9a1 1 0 0 1 1-1z\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M9 8V2\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>
Web UI 是 rvcnext/webui/ 下的一个 Vue 3 项目，同时也是一个 Python 包：构建产物 dist/ 被 git 忽略，作为包数据打进 wheel，由 API 的 SPAStaticFiles` 提供（见 API 与事件）。

「资源」（asset）指 RVC Next 运行时需要、但不随 Python 包分发的模型文件：HuBERT、RMVPE（及其 ONNX 版）、FCPE、CREPE、训练底模和人声分离权重。

RVC Next 的测试有一个前提：默认测试套件离线、只用 CPU、不需要下载任何东西，在一台没有 GPU、没有声卡的机器上几分钟内跑完。做到这一点靠三样东西：随机初始化的 tiny 模型、模拟的 PortAudio 后端和模拟的分离器，以及在临时目录里构建的服务。需要真实模型或原版仓库的测试打上标记，默认不选。

The RVC Next server listens only on the local machine by default (127.0.0.1:7868), so only browsers on that computer can open it. This page explains how to allow other devices on the local network to connect and the protections the server applies.
Remote access and security — RVC Next
An integrated rewrite of Retrieval-based Voice Conversion (RVC): conversion, live voice conversion, vocal separation, training and model management.

After installing RVC Next, follow the entire first-run process: start the web interface, learn where data is stored, download HuBERT and RMVPE for conversion, get a demo voice and complete a conversion. Each step includes both web interface and command-line instructions.

This section explains how to use each page of the RVC Next web interface.

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-book-open\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"M12 5v16\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M20.001 19A2 2 0 0022 17V5a2 2 0 00-1.999-2L16 3.002A5 5 0 0012 5a5 5 0 00-4-2H4a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 001.999 2H8a5 5 0 014 2 5 5 0 014-2z\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>

The overall layout of the RVC Next web interface and the parts shared across pages: navigation, top bar, bottom action bar, job cards, results list and handoffs between pages. Learning these makes the guides for individual pages much easier to follow.

The Convert page changes audio files to the selected voice. It handles single files, multiple files or an entire folder, and can separate vocals before conversion and add the accompaniment back afterward to make a song cover in one operation.

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-audio-lines\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"M2 10v3\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M6 6v11\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M10 3v18\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M14 8v7\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M18 5v13\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M22 10v3\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>

The Live page converts microphone audio into the selected voice in real time, then sends it to headphones, speakers or a virtual audio device (for streaming or voice chat, for example). From top to bottom, the page has three sections: audio devices, voice and parameters, and buffering and noise reduction. The Start / Stop button and status bar stay fixed at the bottom.

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-mic\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"M12 19v3\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M19 10v2a7 7 0 0 1-14 0v-2\">\x3C/path>\x3Crect x=\"9\" y=\"2\" width=\"6\" height=\"13\" rx=\"3\">\x3C/rect>\x3C/svg>

Send the converted voice from Live into Discord, Zoom, OBS, a game or any other program as if it were a microphone: a virtual audio device on Windows (VB-CABLE or Voicemeeter), macOS (BlackHole) and Linux (a PipeWire or PulseAudio virtual microphone), set up step by step.

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-cable\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"M17 19a1 1 0 0 1-1-1v-2a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2a1 1 0 0 1-1 1z\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M17 21v-2\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M19 14V6.5a1 1 0 0 0-7 0v11a1 1 0 0 1-7 0V10\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M21 21v-2\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M3 5V3\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M4 10a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h4a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v2a2 2 0 0 1-2 2z\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M7 5V3\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>

The Separate page uses RoFormer models to split audio: separate songs into vocals and accompaniment, remove reverb from vocals, and separate lead and backing vocals. Multiple steps can be chained into one preset, and any resulting stem can be sent directly to Convert.

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-split\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"M16 3h5v5\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M8 3H3v5\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M12 22v-8.3a4 4 0 0 0-1.172-2.872L3 3\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"m15 9 6-6\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>

The Train page trains a new voice from your own recordings. Each training run is an experiment: a separate folder containing dataset settings, intermediate results from each stage, checkpoints and training curves. After training, you can try a checkpoint immediately and export it to the voice library with one click when satisfied.

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-graduation-cap\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"M21.42 10.922a1 1 0 0 0-.019-1.838L12.83 5.18a2 2 0 0 0-1.66 0L2.6 9.08a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.832l8.57 3.908a2 2 0 0 0 1.66 0z\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M22 10v6\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M6 12.5V16a6 3 0 0 0 12 0v-3.5\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>
The Models page manages all model files used by rvc-next: your voices, base models for training, vocal separation models, and required assets such as HuBERT and RMVPE. There are five tabs at the top:

\x3Csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-library\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\x3Cpath d=\"m16 6 4 14\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M12 6v14\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M8 8v12\">\x3C/path>\x3Cpath d=\"M4 4v16\">\x3C/path>\x3C/svg>

Voice parameters determine the converted sound: pitch, formant, pitch method, index strength, consonant protection and loudness match, plus the speaker for multi-speaker voices. RVC Next uses the same parameter panel in Convert, Live and Default parameters in voice details, with identical names, ranges, defaults, help and order. The command line and API use the same parameters and ranges.

Start the RVC Next server and web UI from your own Python program (a launcher, a bundle, another WebUI): data and configuration in separate folders, pinned settings, a path prefix, and mounting into an existing FastAPI app.
This page explains how RVC Next selects compute devices and precision, manages GPU memory, and which settings affect speed and live latency.

Core (rvcnext/core/) contains all RVC Next business logic: job scheduling, GPU memory management, asset downloads, the voice library and imports, conversion, vocal separation, training, live voice conversion, and their shared settings, events and database. The API and CLI are thin wrappers; it calls the engine (rvcnext/engine/) through functions and imports torch lazily only inside functions.

RVC Next rewrites the orchestration, storage, process control, and all interfaces of Retrieval-based-Voice-Conversion-WebUI (the original, ~/codeworkspace/Retrieval-based-Voice-Conversion-WebUI, commit 81eed5e), but ports the numerical code rather than reinventing it*

RVC Next's tests follow one premise: the default suite runs offline, on CPU only, without downloads, finishing in minutes on a machine with no GPU or sound card. This relies on three things: randomly initialized tiny models, fake PortAudio and separator backends, and services built in temporary directories. Tests requiring real models or the original repository are marked and deselected by default.
